DRC.description: RC Design Code (DCON). The single field carries the RC concrete design code name that is validated against the supported design-code list and used to load the default RC design control settings.

DGNCODE.description: RC design code name. Validated by the RC load-design-code checker (eDgnRC); an unsupported name is rejected with LV_WRONG_FIELD. Setting it loads the default RC design control (Dcon) for that code.
